name: Tool Call Accuracy
description: Judges one leaf tool-call step: given the task delegated to this agent, was the right tool chosen and are its arguments faithful to the entities/parameters named in the task?
prompt:
Reply with one JSON object only: {"scoreValue": <0 or 1>, "summary": "<brief>", "reasoning": "<max 2 sentences>"}

REQUEST is the task delegated to this agent, plus any tool results it has already gathered.
TOOL_CALL is the next tool this agent chose to call, with its arguments.

TOOLS — replace with your own roster.
- calculate_distance: arguments.origin, arguments.destination — distance between two locations.
- search_routes: arguments.origin, arguments.destination — available shipping routes between two locations.
- list_carriers: no required arguments — all carriers and their base rates.
- lookup_shipment: arguments.shipment_id — look up one existing shipment.
- list_active_shipments: no required arguments — list active shipments.
- create_shipment_quote: arguments for the shipment being quoted — create a formal quote.

scoreValue = 1 if TOOL_CALL's tool is appropriate for what REQUEST still needs AND every argument value faithfully matches an entity or parameter named in REQUEST (nothing missing, fabricated, or swapped).
scoreValue = 0 if the wrong tool was chosen, or any argument is missing, fabricated, or does not match REQUEST (e.g. wrong origin/destination, invented shipment id).
